notes:
Account snapshot: BurstKite runs support for three telco brands (US/EU) handling high seasonality (billing cycles, outages). Primary pain = reliability during bursts: incident floods (carrier outages) and promotions drive 6-10x spikes; current NLU platform falls over or returns degraded summaries. Key ask: agent assist and tool-calling must remain responsive under 5-10x baseline surge; graceful degradation preferred over hard failures.

Recent timeline / activity:
- 2026-02-12: Intro call (Maya + Arjun). They described worst-case: 30k concurrent chats across brands during outages; current LLM gateway throttles and queues, agents time out.
- 2026-02-18: Fireflies meeting (ff_2026-02-18_burstkite_intro) - demo request for spike resilience & routing.
- 2026-02-25: Spike planning call with infra (ff_2026-02-25_spike-plan-call). Agreed pilot: 3-week POC (smoke, scale, soak).
- 2026-03-05: Sent security questionnaire + pricing deck (drive:/BurstKite/Redwood_POC_Pricing_2026_v2.pdf). Legal requested SOC2 evidence and data residency options.
- 2026-03-08: SE deep-dive with infra team; outlined canary fallback and warm standby options.

Requirements summary (customer language snippets):
- "Agent suggestions must be below 300ms p95 for 1:1 assist during spikes" - critical for UX.
- End-to-end ticket summarize + suggested reply <= 800ms p95 when under normal load; degrade to partial summary + note that full summary pending if overloaded.
- Support routing/reranking must not exceed 500ms per call.
- Tool-calls: must guarantee idempotency and transactional visibility (we need audit log hooks).
- Throughput targets: baseline 200 rps across 3 brands; must sustain bursts to 1400-2000 rps for 10-30 minutes.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to pay for dedicated pools but want optimization suggestions (quantization, batching, cache TTLs).

Architectural and constraints notes:
- On-prem proxy between Redwood control plane and their VPC required; vendor access limited to staging subnet.
- Strong preference for Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) + private control plane for EU brand data.
- Need KMS integration and audit logs forwarded to SIEM.
- Legal: clause around storing customer transcripts for evals - likely need opt-in/retention controls.

POC plan (agreed rough outline):
1) Week 0: Provision dedicated test pool, SSO sandbox, and test accounts; load generator setup to mimic burst profiles.
2) Week 1 (smoke): Validate integration (Zendesk/ServiceNow toy flows), function-calling for ticket update, basic agent-assist latency.
3) Week 2 (scale): Run synthetic bursts (1x, 3x, 6x baseline). Measure p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost, error rates, queue lengths. Test fallback policies: smaller model variant + cached summaries.
4) Week 3 (soak + runbook): Long-duration 30-90m bursts; finalize config for batching, cache TTLs, routing policies. Deliver runbook & failure modes.

POC success criteria (customer):
- p95 latency for agent_assist <= 300ms under 3x surge; <= 450ms under 6x surge with graceful degradation.
- No more than 2% dropped tool-calls during peak (retries acceptable).
- Ability to switch to warm-standby cheaper model within 5s of overload detection.
- Audit logs delivered to their SIEM within 2 minutes.

Open questions / AE notes:
- Need formal EU data residency plan for EU brand - Redwood Private or Dedicated region? SE to propose options.
- Pricing for sustained reserved capacity + burst credits - customer wants sample TCO for 12 month commit.
- Confirm function-calling guarantee semantics (exact-once vs at-least-once) and retry patterns.

Quotes from the last call: "If we lose the assistants during a billing outage, our CSAT tanks in hours - this is an ops problem, not a feature ask."

Next steps (action items):
- Redwood SE (Arjun) to deliver spike test plan and exact test vectors by 2026-03-14.
- Infra contact to provide VPC peering/window for staging (BurstKite infra: infra-window@burstkite.com).
- Legal to receive SOC2 artifacts and data-residency options by 2026-03-20 (owner: Maya).
- Schedule initial smoke test week starting 2026-03-22 (tentative).

CRM tone: short bullets, some shorthand. High propensity to convert if spike tests pass and EU residency option acceptable.
